messages:
ella: Noting a burst of SAST/DAST failures in checkout-api CI right after yesterday's KMS key rotation + RBAC tighten. Started ~11:05 UTC, affects generated code under gen/ and a few test helpers. Anyone investigating?

ops-bot: CI summary: 12 failures across policy 'sdlc-core'. Top rules: SQL-heuristic, shell-exec-pattern. Scanner v1.4.2. Report: https://ci.internal/report/3532101111

tom: Example failure snippet attached in CI. Looks like generated debug helpers emit f-strings that the SAST flags. I suspect codegen fell back to local templates.

ella: Can RBAC/KMS cause this? We rotated the KMS key for artifact signing and also tightened a service role used by codegen to read the internal template bucket. If codegen lost read perms it will use fallback templates.

sec-bot: Incident created: INCIDENT-901 - "scan noise after codegen template access failure". https://incidents.internal/901

ella: Action plan: 1) Tom to diff generated output with and without template-store access; 2) Ops to temporarily restore read perm in staging and re-run CI; 3) If FP, prepare suppression for gen/ and update premerge rules. Owners/ETAs?

tom: I'll take diffs now, ETA 45m.

ops-bot: Restored codegen SA read in staging. Re-triggering pipelines.

ops-bot: CI re-run: 0 new matches for the flagged rules.

ella: Great. Tom please open suppression PR for historical branches and add a unit test asserting no production code matches. Ops: add a step to the KMS rotation playbook to verify codegen SA perms after role changes.

tom: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/security/pulls/601 - suppression + evidence. Added test.

ella: Thanks all. Leaving thread open until playbook change lands. Ping here for updates. :white_check_mark:
